claim_text: Imbad0202/academic-research-skills is a Claude Code skill suite covering research → write → review → revise → finalize.
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills is at version v3.15.0 as of 2026-07-05.
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills has 36.3k GitHub stars.
The Imbad0202 deep-research skill uses a 13-agent pipeline with 8 modes.
The Imbad0202 deep-research skill covers systematic review, meta-analysis, source verification, risk-of-bias assessment, and APA 7.0 compilation.
199-biotechnologies/claude-deep-research-skill is an enterprise-grade 8-phase skill with source credibility scoring and automated validation.
199-biotechnologies/claude-deep-research-skill includes validate_report.py and verify_citations.py for validation.
199-biotechnologies/claude-deep-research-skill has 814 GitHub stars.
standardhuman/deep-research-skill is a 7-phase system for decision-grade, auditable, hallucination-resistant outputs.
standardhuman/deep-research-skill uses Graph of Thoughts and domain overlays for healthcare/finance/legal/market research.
standardhuman/deep-research-skill has 20 GitHub stars.
Weizhena/Deep-Research-skills supports Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with human-in-the-loop control.
Weizhena/Deep-Research-skills uses a two-phase workflow: outline generation and deep investigation.
Weizhena/Deep-Research-skills has 1.5k GitHub stars.
jamoeight/claude-code-deep-research-v2 supports novel hypothesis generation and evaluator-driven search.
jamoeight v2 has three modes: STANDARD, DISCOVERY, and GENERATOR-EVALUATOR.
jamoeight v2 claims a +10.3 pp benchmark improvement from AggAgent replacing flat synthesis.
jamoeight v2 claims 85-98% context-token cost reduction from context-engineering primitives.
jamoeight v2 provides a research report with 105 citations documenting design decisions.
GPT Researcher is an autonomous agent for web and local research using any LLM provider.
GPT Researcher has 28.1k GitHub stars.
STORM is an LLM-powered knowledge curation system generating full-length reports with citations.
STORM uses a pre-writing research stage and a writing stage to generate Wikipedia-like articles.
STORM has 29.8k GitHub stars.
LangChain Open Deep Research is a configurable open-source agent across model providers, search tools, and MCP servers.
LangChain Open Deep Research claims #6 ranking on Deep Research Bench with score 0.4344.
LangChain Open Deep Research has 11.9k GitHub stars.
MiroThinker-1.7 achieves 74.0 on BrowseComp and 75.3 on BrowseComp-Zh.
MiroThinker has 8.3k GitHub stars.
dzhng/deep-research is an iterative deep research agent combining search, scraping, and LLMs.
dzhng/deep-research is designed to stay under 500 lines of code.
dzhng/deep-research has 19.3k GitHub stars.
Jina AI node-DeepResearch iteratively searches, reads webpages, and reasons until an answer is found.
Jina AI node-DeepResearch focuses on concise answers rather than long-form reports.
Jina AI node-DeepResearch has 5.2k GitHub stars.
Tosea.ai reviewed 6 GitHub-based AI research skills for academic workflows.
Tosea.ai provided a comparison table of research skills including paper-search-mcp, literature-search, deep-research, literature-review, Oh My Paper, and Academic Research Agent Skill.
Tosea.ai's guide points to Imbad0202/academic-research-skills as the full repository for the Claude Code suite.
The Imbad0202 suite is installed by symlinking skill directories into .claude/skills/.
LangChain blog announced Open Deep Research as a configurable open-source deep research agent.
The top five deep research agent skills are Imbad0202, jamoeight v2, 199-biotechnologies, Weizhena, and standardhuman.
Standalone agents such as STORM and GPT-Researcher are more widely adopted than agent skills but are not deployed as SKILL.md files inside coding agents.
Benchmark claims in this space are often self-reported and should be treated with caution.
The deep-research skill is intended for multi-source research with citation tracking, evidence persistence, and structured report generation.
This research followed the 8-phase ultradeep pipeline described in the deep-research skill methodology.
